topology_mismatch.rectangular_kernel: label_connected_components_with_steps propagates through row and column segments and therefore labels 4-connected components.
topology_mismatch.production_mesh: The shipped plasma cells are hexagons on a half-offset tiling, trimmed at the first wall, with centre-first six-neighbour rings shared by the null search and quadratic derivative operator.
topology_mismatch.risk: At a saddle pinch, a diagonal neck is an edge of the hex mesh but not of the rectangular 4-connected lattice, so the inferred public/private partition can change at the X-point.

kernel.ring_contract: nova.geometry.hexstencil.hex_stencil centre plus six neighbours; the trimmed tessellation packs the same rows
kernel.implementation: The four- and six-neighbour routes share one canonical minimum-label fixpoint driver. The hex route changes only the propagation operator: scatter-min over the supplied fixed-shape centre-first rings, with rings centred on unconfined cells closed.

constructed_pinch_disagreement.verdict: The rectangular proxy severs the one-edge hex neck and shadows the wall cell; the physical hex topology keeps the full confined set joined and admits the wall cell.

same_process_benchmark.production_grid_basis: The banked MAST connectivity lattice is 33 radial by 33 vertical cells, as recorded by the prior component-labelling evidence.
same_process_benchmark.input: A confined elliptical core plus one disconnected pocket, identical for both kernels.
same_process_benchmark.compilation: excluded by one warm call per kernel
same_process_benchmark.synchronization: each timed call blocked until both labels and step count were ready

scalar_catalog_projection.qualification: Arithmetic projection of isolated scalar warm calls, not measured batched campaign throughput.
